items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: We were the house band at the Apollo Theatre, you see... That was Willie's big song at the Apollo Theatre.

ctx.x: And how long did you stay with Willie Bryant?

Well, let me see. We lived in the Savoy and we lived in the Apollo! -- because Willie was popular there. Then we went to... We made a Southern tour... We worked in Buffalo at the Vendome, and then we toured... We went all the way down to... How far did we go? We went to Georgia, Florida I think...
Did you have any bad experiences down there?
